endpoints.description: Verified inbound HTTP routes for a Controller class or API Server boundary. One Controller processor can contain multiple path/method/handler combinations. Omit unknown fields; never assume GET or derive routes from class names. On update omission preserves, an array replaces, [] empties, null clears. Do not use for Filter/Interceptor matching or Advice scope. Stored only in other_info.endpoints; the top-level response is a projection, not a separate stored value. API Server represents one Swagger/OpenAPI operation: endpoints is an array with at most one method/path pair. Different methods or paths require separate processors. Spring Controller classes may have multiple endpoints. Endpoint cardinality follows the storage catalog: is_module=true permits multiple endpoints; false, null or omitted permits at most one. Clients cannot override this flag. This applies to all processor types and both endpoints and other_info.endpoints. Check acceptable_processors or processor_storage_types before writing. Legacy JSON strings encoding an array or null are also accepted, decoded and validated; new writes store arrays or null and top-level endpoints read projections use arrays or null. Existing raw other_info may retain legacy strings until updated. New clients must send arrays. Invalid strings are rejected without clearing metadata.

path.description: Verified request mapping path; resolve class and handler mappings only from evidence.

method.description: Verified HTTP method; omit if unspecified or unknown. Never default to GET.

handler.description: Actual source handler method name without class/package prefix; omit if unknown.

endpoint_id.description: Server-assigned stable Controller endpoint ID. Preserve on edits to retain the contract association.

input_attribute_id.description: Server-managed Controller INPUT Object ID. Preserve on edits; do not invent. Same-handler routes share this ID.

output_attribute_id.description: Server-managed Controller OUTPUT Object ID. Preserve on edits; do not invent. Add verified child fields under this Object.

http_method.description: Deprecated single-endpoint input. Prefer endpoints. Converted to one endpoint; no duplicate routing keys are stored in other_info. Explicit endpoints takes precedence. Partial legacy updates are rejected when multiple endpoints exist.

sub_type.description: Optional free-text refinement of the storage type; alias subType. Examples: controller REST/MVC, service Application/Domain/Facade/AI Service, repository Repository/DAO/Mapper/Memory Repository. See model_selection_guide for the complete recommended Spring subtype catalog; do not create new default types for internal stages.

uri_path.description: Deprecated single-endpoint input. Prefer endpoints. Converted to one endpoint; no duplicate routing keys are stored in other_info. Explicit endpoints takes precedence. Partial legacy updates are rejected when multiple endpoints exist.

subType.description: Alias for sub_type; canonical sub_type takes precedence.
